prompt:
You are a senior Odoo 18 functional consultant. A search agent mapped the business requirement below
to candidate Odoo modules. Check its answer.

Requirement (written by a business analyst, may be in Vietnamese or English):
<<<
Reopen a cancelled transfer so it can be edited and processed again
>>>
English restatement by the search agent: Allow users to reopen a cancelled inventory transfer back to an editable state so that its details can be updated and it can be processed again.

Candidate modules, best first. Everything below comes from a knowledge graph built from the installed
Odoo 18 database (models, fields, dependencies) and from the module documentation.

### Candidate 1: stock_picking_back2draft (OCA module, "Pickings back to draft")
Direct dependencies: stock
Documentation:
# Pickings back to draft

## SUMMARY
Reopen canceled transfers

## DESCRIPTION
This module allows to bring canceled transfers back to draft

## USAGE
Just open a canceled transfer and click on the 'back to draft' button
Business functions (knowledge graph):
- Reopen canceled transfers: Allows users to reset canceled inventory transfers back to the draft state by clicking a button on the canceled picking.
Models (relation of the module to the model; fields the module adds):
- stock.picking (Transfer) [EXTENDS]
- stock.move (Stock Move) [EXTENDS]

### Candidate 2: stock_move_location (OCA module, "Move Stock Location")
Direct dependencies: stock
Documentation:
# Move Stock Location

## SUMMARY
This module allows to move all stock in a stock location to an other one.

## DESCRIPTION
This module allows to move entire location of products from one place to
another and move only selected quantities.

## USAGE
- A new menu item Operations \> Move from location... opens a wizard where 2 locations
  can be specified.
- Select origin and destination locations and press "IMMEDIATE TRANSFER" or "PLANNED
  TRANSFER"
- Those lines can be edited. Move quantity can't be more than a max available quantity
- Move doesn't care about the reservations and will move stuff anyway
- If during your operation with the wizard the real quantity will change it will move
  only the available quantity at the button press
- Products will be moved and a form view of picking that did that will show up
- If "PLANNED TRANSFER" is used - the picking won't be validated automatically

If you want to transfer a full quant:

- Go to Inventory \> Products \> Products and click "On hand" smart button or Inventory
  \> Reporting \> Inventory, the quants view will be opened.
- Select the quantities which you want move to another location

If you go to the Inventory Dashboard you can see the button "Move from location" in each
of the picking types (only applicable to internal and outgoing transfers). Press it and
you will be directed to the wizard.

To enable this option, check "Show Move On Hand Stock" in the Picking Type
configuration.

If you want transfer everything from [...]
Business functions (knowledge graph):
- Fill draft picking with products from source location: Populates a draft picking with stock move lines for all available products in the specified source location.
- Move specific stock quants: Enables users to select specific quants from the product on-hand or inventory reporting views and transfer them to a designated location.
- Move stock between locations via wizard: Transfers entire stock or selected product quantities from an origin location to a destination location using a specialized wizard, supporting both immediate and planned transfers.
Models (relation of the module to the model; fields the module adds):
- stock.picking (Transfer) [EXTENDS]
- stock.picking.type (Picking Type) [ADDS_FIELD, EXTENDS]; adds show_move_onhand
- wiz.stock.move.location (Wizard move location) [ADDS_FIELD, DEFINES]; adds apply_putaway_strategy, company_id, destination_location_disable, destination_location_id, edit_locations, exclude_reserved_qty, origin_location_disable, origin_location_id ...
- wiz.stock.move.location.line (Wizard move location line) [ADDS_FIELD, DEFINES]; adds custom, destination_location_id, lot_id, max_quantity, move_location_wizard_id, move_quantity, origin_location_id, owner_id ...
- stock.move (Stock Move) [ADDS_FIELD, EXTENDS]; adds location_move

### Candidate 3: stock_picking_invoice_link (OCA module, "Stock Picking Invoice Link")
Direct dependencies: stock_account
Documentation:
# Stock Picking Invoice Link

## SUMMARY
Adds link between pickings and invoices

## DESCRIPTION
The base module used by sale_stock_picking_invoice_link and purchase_stock_picking_invoice_link 
to adds a link between pickings and invoices as well as on the lines.

## USAGE
- Create a Sales Order and confirm.
- Deliver its pickings totally or partially.
- Create an invoice of the goods delivered.
- If you open invoice form, you must see a new Pickings tab with
  information about them.
Business functions (knowledge graph):
- Link stock pickings and invoices: Establishes a link between stock pickings and invoices at both the header and line levels, providing visibility of related pickings in a dedicated tab on the invoice.
Models (relation of the module to the model; fields the module adds):
- account.move.reversal (Account Move Reversal) [EXTENDS]
- stock.picking (Transfer) [ADDS_FIELD, EXTENDS]; adds invoice_count, invoice_ids
- stock.move (Stock Move) [ADDS_FIELD, EXTENDS]; adds invoice_line_ids
- account.move (Journal Entry) [ADDS_FIELD, EXTENDS]; adds picking_count, picking_ids
- account.move.line (Journal Item) [ADDS_FIELD, EXTENDS]; adds move_line_ids
- account.bank.statement.line (Bank Statement Line) [ADDS_FIELD, delegated: no code here]; adds picking_count, picking_ids
